description: A React 19 UI kit for glassmorphism interfaces, dashboards and settings, with scoped CSS, local Lamina fonts, editable shadcn components and TypeScript API documentation.
rules: Tenvell targets React and React DOM 19 and modern browser support for CSS @scope and backdrop-filter.
Use the documented HTTPS package archive or shadcn registry installation; the bare npm name is not the documented distribution channel.
Import the stylesheet once and wrap the relevant UI in TenvellProvider. The host application owns layout, background, preferences and persistence.
Individual registry items use their own module paths. Calendar, DataTable, toast and complete product demonstrations are website source examples, not portable core exports.
Dialog and menu triggers use the Base UI render prop. Optional chart shapes require Recharts 3.
